summary: Plastec Technologies filed a 6-K posting its 2025 annual report, which confirms the voluntary liquidation of its BVI subsidiaries Viewmount Development Limited, Sun Ngai Spraying and Silk Print Co. Ltd., and Sun Terrace Industries Ltd. The liquidation began in March 2026 and completed in May 2026, leaving Plastec with no subsidiaries or operating activities. The company retains a debt-free balance sheet with $5.4M cash and $0.41 book value per share. Management indicated it will evaluate new capital deployment opportunities. Watch for potential cash distribution, new business acquisition, or eventual dissolution.
